descriptions.d11c_seek_target_80021bb4: Write 1 to the "AIStrike.SeekTarget" property, then compare the global camera's current mode name (+316 array indexed by +312, name at +60) with a temporary engine string of "Blimp" and, when they differ, switch the camera to "Blimp" through 0x80035714 with blend 0.0.
